messages.subject: Mittens
messages.text:
Do you have plans for mittens with a long cuff/sleeve that can fit around a puffy jacket with the ability to cinch down? If so, I'll be first on your list to buy them please. 

 Thanks for this fabulous idea re: milkweed which I am trying to get my neighbours to plan in their yards.
 

 Take care,
 

 Denise C.

messages.subject: Re: Mittens
messages.text:
Hi Denise!
 

 We dont know if our mittens' cuff is long enough, but it is definitely possible to fit them around a jacket sleeve and cinch them down.
 

 
 

 Feel free if you have any other questions!

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay

 Take care and thanks for getting back to me so quickly,
